TASK:
Implement US-002 + US-003: extract protected concepts via the sidecar keyed by content hash (NG-6, never per request), map the graph to areas, and enforce the 0.80 stability gate (NFR-07). Treat SI null as NOT stable.

CREATE FILES: as listed in manifest.create (AF-202 extract/, AF-203 stability/). Signatures exactly per specs/EP-02-policy-intake/APP-FUNCTIONS.md.

RULES:

6. Report test results after each pair; summary at the end.
